company.name: Productiv
company.shortDescription: Productiv is the only SaaS Intelligence™ platform for SaaS management.
company.description:
Productiv is the only SaaS Intelligence™ platform for SaaS management.

Companies like Fox, Uber, and Zoom use Productiv’s employee-centric, data-driven approach to manage their SaaS portfolios for maximum ROI. By providing real-time employee engagement data down to the feature-level, Productiv helps organizations of all sizes enable proactive governance, increase operational velocity, and supercharge employee engagement.

Productiv is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with offices in San Francisco, Bellevue, and New York. Founded in 2018 and backed by Accel, IVP, and Norwest Venture Partners, Productiv is leading the SaaS Intelligence movement and transforming the way companies think about SaaS management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $45,000,000, or 61.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $32,519,830 to $359,240,748, a 11.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 5 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Sonar, Sintra AI, Zluri.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
